Introducing NeoDoc

Hey folk! I'm Alan and I'd like to introduce
you to NeoDoc. A writing format for the
AT Proto Atmosphere^^1^^. 


-- footnote
-- id: 1

Well. It was originally designed for my
static site generator. But, it's a perfect 
fit for the Atmosphere. 


-- comment

You're seeing the raw format right
now. That's because the parser hasn't been 
integrated into the site yet. That's no 
problem. NeoDoc is designed to be readable 
without extra formatting. If you're
familiar with >>Markdown|
https://www.markdownguide.org/>>, it's
like that, but you can do way more
stuff with it. 

For example, ``-- comment`` sections 
are hidden by default when NeoDocs are 
transformed into web pages. So, this note 
will disappear when the parser is put 
in place.
